messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-10T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Intercom renewal — decision and next steps (support + success tooling)

Team,

Our Intercom contract is up for renewal in April and Legal asked that Procurement provide a recommended path by Feb 1. Given recent CS growth and the new Success playbook, I want us to evaluate three options: renew Intercom as-is, move to Zendesk for support + keep Intercom for chat, or consolidate onto Zendesk + Gainsight for Success.

Primary asks from me today:
- Quick cost delta (TCO over 12 months) for each option (license + PS/migration)
- Technical feasibility and estimated hours to export & migrate historical conversations and attachments
- Operational impact: agent seats vs concurrent seats, SLA differences, data residency constraints
- Any upstream sales/customer risk if we request credits or SLA guarantees

I attached our vendor comparison and the current contract for reference. Please reply with a short summary and a recommended recommendation by EOD Tue (2027-01-12).

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: vendor_comparison_20270110.xlsx, intercom_current_contract.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal — decision and next steps (support + success tooling)

On Mon, Jan 10, 2027 at 09:22 Aisha Rahman wrote:
> Team,
> Our Intercom contract is up for renewal...

Quick back-of-envelope on licensing TCO (12-month):
- Renew Intercom (status quo): ~$210k (current seats + 10% growth cushion)
- Zendesk (Support Suite) + keep Intercom chat: ~$260k + migration cost for Support (~$40–60k one-time)
- Zendesk + Gainsight (consolidation): ~$340k (higher but reduces cross-tool overhead)

Notes: these are list numbers — discounts we can target are 10–25% depending on commitment and whether we consolidate purchases. Also, Intercom PS for data export tends to be charged hourly; expect $8–15k depending on complexity.

I'll tag Dev for technical export details and Marissa for impact on CS flows.

— Karthik
VP, Product Ops

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-11T13:55:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal — decision and next steps (support + success tooling)

Aisha / Karthik —

Technical takeaways:
- Intercom provides data export via their API and workspace export tool but attachments and long threads require staged export. We can do a full export of conversation transcripts + meta in ~40–60 engineering hours (estimate 1.5–2 weeks of a senior engineer plus QA). Attachments will add time (~10–20h) due to storage/transfer verification.
- Zendesk import is straightforward (ticket import API + CSV); Gainsight will need mapping for account-level signals (we'll need a schema mapping exercise).
- Key risks: preserving message threading and custom attributes (we run custom tags in Intercom). We'll need a mapping spec and a reconciliation pass.

I dropped a short export plan in the drive (linked). If we decide to engage Intercom PS, they can accelerate but will charge.

Dev
Senior Backend Engineer

Attachments: export_plan.md

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-12T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal — decision and next steps (support + success tooling)

Folks —

From a CS perspective:
- SLA / routing: Intercom's standard SLA on response is decent for async chat, but they lack mature multi-channel routing compared to Zendesk. Our CS agents are already stretched during launches and a migration window would increase queue time.
- Agent ergonomics: Zendesk + Sunshine has better ticket triage for escalation flows; Gainsight adds health scoring that our AMs want.
- Customer-facing risk: we should not disrupt customers with long downtime — propose a staged migration and a pilot with 10% of traffic. We should also demand a migration assistance clause + at least one week of dedicated PS hours included.

If Procurement wants leverage: ask Intercom for a migration credit (hours) + 12–15% discount or we'll consolidate to Zendesk + Gainsight. That yields the best negotiating posture.

Marissa
Head of Customer Success

Attachment: customer-impact-notes.docx

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-14T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal — decision and next steps (support + success tooling)

Thanks — good input. Proposed negotiation posture for Procurement + Legal to take to Intercom:
- Target discount: 15% off current list for a 12-month commit (ask for 20% as anchor)
- Migration support: include 40 hours of Intercom PS for free (or equivalent credit) for export/import assistance
- SLA addendum: priority routing for incidents impacting >5% of customers for 24 hours and a credit formula defined in the amendment
- Data export clause: machine-readable archive of all conversations and attachments on contract termination/renewal windows

If Intercom won't meet those, we push consolidation route (Zendesk + Gainsight) and ask SLT for migration budget authorization (~$60k one-time).

Legal: please review the attached redline and advise if this posture is reasonable to send to Intercom.

Aisha

Attachments: intercom_amendment_redline.pdf

From: Jane Taylor <jane.taylor@intercom.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-01-18T16:40:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Intercom renewal — decision and next steps (support + success tooling)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear summary and the redline. We're keen to keep Redwood as a customer and can be flexible. Initial concessions we can offer:
- 12-month renewal at 10% off list immediately (we can review 15% if Redwood agrees to add Chat Assist and a usage minimum)
- We will include 30 hours of complimentary PS to help with workspace export and verification; additional hours billed at our standard rate (we can discount those 15%)
- We can add a data export clause that provides a machine-readable archive on termination; we typically provide a 30-day export window via secure download
- SLA amendment: we can add a priority incident response commitment with a credit formula similar to what you proposed (legal to finalize wording)

I'll loop in our contracting team. If you'd like something inked quickly we can send a version via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/XYZ-Intercom-Amendment

Let me know if you want me to include a PS scope-of-work estimate (we can turn that around in 48 hours).

Best,
Jane Taylor
Enterprise Account Exec, Intercom
